children.text: Cuba, Puerto Rico, and the Historical Paths Between Them

The histories of Cuba and Puerto Rico have developed through interconnected but distinct experiences of colonialism, emancipation, political struggle, migration, and cultural exchange. This interactive chronology brings together selected events from both islands to examine how their historical trajectories converged, diverged, and continued to influence one another.
